q2_gaps: a counted temporal NP as a time adjunct ("on the thirtieth night of the solo stretch"): the Time value slot is specified only for structured calendar terms and bare deictic / day-part symbols, so an interval-internal counted night has no licensed filler (the parse improvises (Time sk_light_1 sk_night_1) with an entity witness)

an ordinal restricted by a role or phase ("her first lantern as a Keeper", "the thirtieth night of the solo stretch"): Ordinal has entity / rank / scale slots only and nowhere to carry the restricting domain
the directional / restitutive adverb "back" in "walked back to Aelmere": it is neither a Manner adverb nor the Again particle, and has no licensed slot
notes: The collective readings for "met" and "walked ... together", the common-noun default for "the Council" (no Name atom), the invested-as-a-Keeper result-state shape, and the "every villager present" distribution rule with its QuantifierPhrase companion are all handled per the instruction set. The PartOf choices for "the lantern of the Harbor Station" and "the thirtieth night of the solo stretch" are borderline against the opaque Possession but defensible.
